meta.name: ai-research-explore
meta.description: Rigor Explore compatible skill slug for meaningful and potentially novel deep learning research candidates. Use when the researcher has chosen the task family, dataset, benchmark, evaluation method, provided SOTA references, and wants candidate-only exploration on top of `current_research` with auditable repo understanding, idea gating, fair comparison, and governed experiments written to `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for README-first trusted reproduction, open-ended direction finding, narrow code-only or run-only exploration, passive repo analysis, verified novelty claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你从现有成果出发，筛选有潜力的深度学习新方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做研究中已有一定的对比结果，想探索新想法
copy.tagline_en: Find and vet novel deep learning research directions from your current results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have baselines and want to explore new research ideas

howto.what: 在已获授权的候选探索里,Claude 会理解仓库、冻结任务与评估口径、对有边界的候选想法做门控打分和排序,一次只推进一个改动或试跑,并把结果写入 explore_outputs/ 等目录。
howto.when: 当你已选好任务族、数据集、评估方法等,给出 SOTA 参考,并明确授权候选探索且有 current_research 锚点时接管;仅代码或仅运行的窄探索不归它管。

say.text: 冻结任务、数据集和评估口径,列出候选想法并排序
say.note: 会写入门控与打分拆解

say.text: 用 explore-code 对某个候选做一个有边界的小改动
用实测证据把候选和 current_research 锚点对比排序

howto.what_en: With explicit candidate-exploration authorization, Claude reads the repo, freezes task and evaluation, gates and ranks candidate ideas, makes one bounded change or run at a time, and writes results to explore_outputs/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have chosen the task family, dataset and evaluation method, given SOTA references, and hold explicit explore-lane authorization plus a durable current_research anchor.

say_en.text: Freeze the task, dataset and evaluation, then list and rank candidate ideas.
Use explore-code to make one bounded change to a candidate.
say_en.note: Keeps the patch small and auditable.

say_en.text: Rank candidates against the current_research anchor using real evidence.
